records.title: SpeakerMem-R1: Speaker-Centered Dual-Track Memory for Multi-Party Dialogue
records.reason: SpeakerMem-R1 is a speaker-centered memory design for multi-party dialogue; no inference-cost or serving optimization is described.

records.title: Polylogarithmic Collective Tree Exploration
records.reason: Polylogarithmic collective tree exploration is an algorithmic result for asynchronous multi-agent tree traversal, unrelated to language-model serving.

records.title: Harness as a Language: A Minimalist Agent Framework With Maximal Expressivity
records.reason: JAZ presents a minimalist LLM agent framework and reports workflow task/cost results, but the abstract does not identify a concrete inference/serving efficiency method; cost comparison is application-level harness performance.

records.title: Building Socio-Affective Artificial Intelligence for Interactive Multi-Agent Simulations
records.reason: The paper presents socio-affective multi-agent simulation architecture; it does not concern LLM inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: AI-Enabled Wireless Propagation Modeling and Radio Environment Maps for 5G Aerial Wireless Networks
records.reason: The work models 5G aerial wireless propagation with Transformer and GRU components; this is a radio-environment prediction application, not LLM inference optimization.
